Initial release of smyx-leaf-curling-scorch-diagnosis-analysis:

- Enables high-resolution plant leaf image analysis using AI to detect leaf curling direction and leaf-margin scorch distribution.
- Integrates optional soil moisture sensor data to help identify likely causes such as drought, disease, pesticide or fertilizer issues.
- Provides prioritized diagnosis and actionable care suggestions for farmers across open-field, greenhouse, and orchard scenarios.
- Supports inspection via agricultural cameras, UAVs, or mobile apps, and can be integrated into agricultural IoT platforms.
- Includes strict open-id management and process controls for secure and accurate user/report tracking.
- Offers automatic generation and cloud-based querying of historical diagnosis reports, with results shown as clear Markdown tables.
